enchantments.tooltip: Constitution +13: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Vitality +44: Passive: +44 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.
Fortitude Save +11: This item gives a +11 Resistance bonus to your Fortitude saves.
Fortification +142%: +142% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Trace of Madness: You can almost hear faint, panicked voices when this item is close to you. Perhaps the latent power of this item's hint of madness could be brought out by some catalyst.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
